title: Cops launch 'serious' Bigfoot probe after sightings before shock discovery
excerpt: A town was left on high alert after several residents reported seeing a sasquatch wandering around their streets - although the hairy beast turned out to be not quite what it seemed

A town was left on high alert after several residents reported seeing a sasquatch wandering around their streets - although the hairy beast turned out to be not quite what it seemed

10:21, 07 Sep 2026

Residents of a small town were left red-faced after a spate of reported Bigfoot sightings turned out to be a bloke in a furry jacket.

‌

Cops in Damariscotta in Maine, US, reported an "unusually high number of calls" regarding the iconic beast, with multiple locals phoning in with fears of a "very large and hairy individual roaming around town".

‌

However the sightings had a slightly less exotic explanation than it being a real visit from a sasquatch.

‌

According to a police statement, the so-called Bigfoot was actually just a bloke with a beard and a furry coat. Posting on Facebook, Damariscotta Police Dept offered an "official update", reminding residents that "Bigfoot is not real".

‌

“After a lengthy, exhaustive, and completely serious investigation, members of the Damariscotta Police Department have reached a conclusion: Bigfoot is not real,” cops said.

“We understand this may be disappointing to some. Frankly, there were members of our department who were secretly hoping we had finally stumbled upon something that would make national news.”

The man, who has not been named, apparently had a "great conversation" with cops when approached, with the responding officer finding "no evidence of criminal activity, no indication of anything nefarious afoot, and unfortunately, no ground-breaking discovery of a previously unknown species."

‌

While the man's unique looking outfit has been described as a "costume" by cops, it is unclear whether the garb was part of a deliberate hoax or if he just fancied standing out from the crowd.

Unsurprisingly, several social media users poked fun at "trigger happy" residents, with one joking that the man "looked more like a large Yorkshire terrier" than a sasquatch, while another wrote: "You can tell we live in a small town".

‌

They said: "We greatly appreciate everyone’s excitement, curiosity, and willingness to keep an eye out for one another. We also appreciate all the calls and information that came in. Rest assured, we were on the hunt from the very beginning.

"While we didn't find Bigfoot, we did find something almost as rare: A town full of people willing to stop what they're doing to investigate a Bigfoot sighting and keep each other safe. And honestly, we wouldn't have it any other way.
